description: Thresholds for the naturally discovered hypothesis Brain. Every value here is a development default chosen so the five lifecycle operations are all reachable on a short replay; none of them has been fitted or validated against out-of-sample outcomes.

proposer._minimum_prior_note: The share of retrieved neighbours a mode needs before it is named specifically. Below it, the proposer climbs to the mode's ancestor instead: an ambiguous neighbourhood supports a coarser claim, not a confident fine one. With six leaves a uniform split gives each 0.167, so a threshold under that never engages the roll-up at all.
